selection_disclosure.consequence: This audit may diagnose observed mechanisms but cannot claim an unbiased discovery or future profitability. Every replacement requires a separately frozen chronological test.

problem_restatement.input: One running V85 mainnet cohort with seven required assets, nine monitored provider-symbol routes, and eight routes holding execution authority.
problem_restatement.required_output: Reconcile every observed entry, protection order, exit, and after-cost outcome; identify technical faults and repeated negative mechanisms; and define a complete V86 successor without silently removing a required asset.
success_criteria: the exact run, profile, ledger prefix, route directions, and execution contracts are immutable inputs
all nine monitored routes and all eight executable routes are represented
every closed lifecycle reconciles entry, protection, exit, fees, funding, MFE, MAE, and peak giveback
technical faults are separated from statistical losses and insufficient samples
a route that fails the explicit bankroll-quality rule receives no execution authority in V86
each of the seven required assets retains at least one independently supported executable route before V86 can be considered complete

classification_contract.technical_fault: Identity drift, missing route telemetry, malformed lifecycle, uncovered open position, rejected or partial order inconsistency, non-contiguous prefix, or runtime behavior that differs from its frozen execution contract.
classification_contract.negative_signal: A route has non-positive exact live net evidence and also fails a frozen out-of-sample, pseudo-holdout, worst-fold, or leave-largest-winner criterion. A single live loss without corroborating frozen evidence is insufficient.
classification_contract.exit_leakage: A closed lifecycle clears the robust after-cost MFE hurdle but realizes a loss after surrendering that excursion. One occurrence is an observed mechanism; repeated independent occurrences are required to call it a route-level defect.
classification_contract.execution_drag: Observed fees and slippage turn a positive gross lifecycle or independently resolved signal set non-positive after costs; modeled and observed costs must be reported separately.
classification_contract.insufficient_evidence: The exact route has too few independent live outcomes to identify expectancy and no frozen corroborating failure.
classification_contract.no_observed_issue: The route is technically coherent and has positive, robust evidence under the frozen tests; this label is not a profitability guarantee.

successor_authority_policy.no_supported_same_asset_replacement: V86 remains incomplete and disarmed; the asset is not silently removed and the failed route is not relabeled as passing.

predeclared_hypotheses.basis: negative frozen pseudo-holdout plus two exact live losses
predeclared_hypotheses.falsifier: A correctly scoped frozen evidence artifact shows positive worst-fold, positive leave-largest, and reconciles the exact live losses to a separate technical defect.

predeclared_hypotheses.basis: failed frozen leave-largest criterion plus one exact live stop after an approximately 80-bps favorable excursion
predeclared_hypotheses.falsifier: An independently frozen chronological replacement test passes every cost, fold, and leave-largest criterion; changing only the historical interpretation does not falsify the current-route diagnosis.
The immutable audit finds a technical inconsistency or corroborated frozen negative evidence under the classification contract.
